m1.typescript: m1 each file is reviewed alone and the cross pass reads their summaries

e1.typescript: e1 a file pass sees only its own file and the cross pass sees summaries never the text

e2.typescript: e2 a long file is reviewed in labelled parts and a blank file is skipped

e3.typescript: e3 a failing file is reported and left out of the cross pass which needs two files

e4.typescript: e4 the planner is asked again after each step with the steps so far and the loop ends when it says done

e5.typescript: e5 the loop stops on a repeated subtask or no next step or an unreadable reply and counts the step limit exactly

e6.typescript: e6 the strategy follows what is known about the steps and whether the items interact

wrong-shared-context.defect: gives each file pass the text of every file

wrong-cross-gets-text.defect: hands the cross pass the file text beside the summaries

wrong-no-chunking.defect: sends a long file in one piece whatever the limit

wrong-blank-reviewed.defect: reviews a file that holds only blank lines

wrong-failed-in-cross.defect: keeps a failed file among the reviewed ones

wrong-cross-with-one.defect: runs the cross pass when only one file was reviewed

wrong-no-history.defect: asks the planner without the steps done so far

wrong-repeat-allowed.defect: lets the planner repeat a subtask

wrong-limit-off-by-one.defect: runs one step more than the step limit

wrong-strategy-items-first.defect: chooses per item and cross even when the steps are not known
